description: This file is an implementation class (`DatatypeServiceImpl`) within the OpenMRS core API module. It provides methods to manage custom data types and their handlers, interfacing with the database and handling component registration. The class implements the `DatatypeService` interface and extends `BaseOpenmrsService`, with transaction management annotations.

classes.name: DatatypeServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the DatatypeService interface, providing methods to handle custom data types, handlers, and database storage management within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: setDao
methods.description: Sets the DatatypeDAO instance used for database access.

methods.name: getAllDatatypeClasses
methods.description: Returns all registered custom datatype classes.

methods.name: getAllHandlerClasses
methods.description: Returns all registered custom datatype handler classes.

methods.name: populateBeanListsFromContext
methods.description: Loads datatype and handler classes from the application context.

methods.name: getDatatype
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a custom datatype class with the given configuration.

methods.name: getHandlerClasses
methods.description: Returns handler classes that can handle a specific datatype.

methods.name: datatypeClassHandled
methods.description: Determines the main datatype class from a generic type.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns a handler instance for a specific datatype and configuration.

methods.name: prioritizeHandlers
methods.description: Prioritizes available handlers for each datatype for quick access.

methods.name: saveClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Saves a ClobDatatypeStorage object to the database.

methods.name: deleteClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Deletes a ClobDatatypeStorage object from the database.
